    lines.append("")

        # Calculate column widths for alignment
        col_widths = [0] * len(rows[0])
        for row in rows:
            for i, cell in enumerate(row):
                if i < len(col_widths):
                    col_widths[i] = max(col_widths[i], len(cell))
        # Format each row
        for row in rows:
            formatted = " | ".join(cell.ljust(col_widths[i]) if i < len(col_widths) else cell for i, cell in enumerate(row))
            lines.append(formatted)
    lines.append("")

output_text = "\n".join(lines)
print(f"Total sheets: {len(data)}, total lines: {len(lines)}")
print("Preview:\n" + "\n".join(lines[:30]))
